proof_level: Real Wayland input delivered to production GTK gestures; callbacks observed without an executing runner or controller
scope_limits: No action runner/controller, keyboard or clipboard effects, HID operations or host switching. All executable fixture branches were literal /usr/bin/true and were not executed.
Native release was intentionally not required after each of six ring-unmap cancellation cases; all helper release/flush/sync/reap checks were still mandatory.
Zero-timestamp motion and programmatic/duplicate release signals were explicitly excluded from native evidence.
Internal nonfatal GDK frame-timing warnings were logged; these runs are not warning-free.
This verifies the identified ring sources, not later surrounding application changes or physical human drag/thumb-wheel feel.
